title: The Thousand Years (the Millennium)
lead: The only place the Bible speaks of a thousand-year reign is Revelation 20:1–7. Christians have read it as a future reign of Christ on earth (premillennial), as the present church age (amillennial), or as a golden age before his return (postmillennial), and have read the prophets' pictures of a renewed world (Isaiah 11:6–9; Isaiah 24:21–23; Isaiah 65:17–25) and Jewish hopes for a messianic age (1 Enoch 10:17–19) in its light.
